The stock closed at 333.42, trading above the 50-day simple moving average of 326.21 and the 20-day simple moving average of 330.47 while maintaining an uptrend state [D1]. The immediate support high edge sits at 332.78 with a strength rating of 59, whereas the immediate resistance high edge is located at 366.41 with a strength rating of 3 [D1]. Recent technical indicators show a relative strength index of 54.21 and a MACD value of -1.45 against a signal line of -1.84, suggesting the momentum remains constructive despite minor bearish crossovers [D1]. The company reported revenue of 1846000000 for the quarter ended 2026-07-31, which represents a 36 percent increase year over year and exceeds analyst expectations of 1750000000 [D1][D2]. Net income reached 397000000 or 2.30 per share on a GAAP basis, while non-GAAP net income was 531000000 or 3.07 per share, both figures surpassing market consensus [D1][D2].

Management raised its full-year fiscal 2026 outlook, projecting fourth quarter revenue between 1930000000 and 1950000000 with non-GAAP earnings per share expected to range from 3.34 to 3.40 [D1][D3]. This guidance implies a year-over-year growth of approximately 37 percent at the midpoint, significantly higher than the prior quarter's expectations and well above the analyst consensus of 1820000000 for the quarter [D2][D3]. The company delivered record orders totaling 2091000000, a 56 percent increase from the prior year, driven largely by AI infrastructure demand in the wireline segment where revenue surpassed wireless revenue for the first time [D1][D3]. Operating margin expanded to 33.2 percent, up more than 800 basis points from the previous year, reflecting strong operating leverage and disciplined cost management [D3]. Free cash flow generation reached 403000000, providing substantial financial flexibility alongside a cash balance of 2605000000 as of July 31, 2026 [D1][D3].

The market is arguing about the sustainability of this growth given emerging supply chain constraints that management describes as a governor on near-term revenue conversion for the next several quarters [D3][D4]. While demand continues to exceed supply capabilities, particularly in AI infrastructure and wireline markets, executives caution that the supply environment is less flexible than a year ago and may limit the ability to convert backlog into revenue nonlinearly over the coming quarters [D3][D4]. Analysts have responded positively with a mean price target of 418.42, indicating a potential upside of 30 percent from current levels, though some note that valuation leaves little room for error given the high growth expectations [D7]. The consensus view among analysts is strengthened by a tight clustering of price targets and a strong agreement on the company's ability to report better earnings than previously predicted [D7].

The plan therefore involves maintaining a bullish stance supported by the substantial gap between management's raised guidance and existing analyst forecasts, which suggests strong demand could continue beyond the latest quarter [D2]. Investors should monitor the supply chain situation closely as it remains the primary constraint on revenue realization despite robust order intake and pipeline growth [D3][D4]. The company expects to realize 80 percent to 90 percent of its 100000000 in cost synergies on a run-rate basis by the end of the fiscal year, further supporting margin expansion [D3]. With integration efforts largely complete and systems migrations finished one quarter ahead of schedule, management is positioned to capture value from recent acquisitions while navigating the tighter supply environment [D3][D4].
